title: Abandon does not let the player choose which spell to counter when multiple spells are on the chain
expected: Abandon's rulesText is parsed at load (enrich-cards.ts) into a `sequence` effect: [{type:'counter',destination:'hand'},{type:'predict',amount:1}] (verified by running parseAbilities). The play-spell enumerator only emits per-chain-item target variants when the TOP-LEVEL effect is a counter: play-spell.ts:1186 `else if (spellEffect?.type === "counter") { ...baseVariants.push({targets:[key]}) }`; a sequence falls through to the `else` at ~1207 which pushes a variant with no targets. Likewise isCounterSpell at play-spell.ts:390 checks only top-level type. With no boundTargets, handle_counter (abilities/effects/counter.ts, loop `for (let i = items.length-1; i>=0; i--)`) picks the topmost legal spell, so Premonition is auto-countered and Mobilize can never be chosen. Bare "Counter a spell" cards (e.g. ogn-064) work because their effect is a top-level counter; Abandon's trailing [Predict] wraps it in a sequence and bypasses the targeting branch.
observed: playSpell for Abandon was offered with no targets param and no pendingChoice appeared; chain item had no target recorded ({type:'counter',destination:'hand'}). On resolution it auto-countered the topmost spell (Premonition, returned to hand) — no way to counter Mobilize instead
